Page.description: Keep a simple todo list for each day: add, edit, delete, and optionally mark items as complete.

Sidebar.description: The left side handles dates and recent lists, while the right side focuses on today's todos.

DeleteDay.confirm: Delete all {count} tasks for {date}, including completed and optional tasks? This cannot be undone.
DeleteDay.success: This day's schedule has been deleted.

Import.title: Import schedules
Import.hint: Choose one or more UTF-8 Markdown files. The heading date is used by default; adjust it in the preview. New titles are appended without overwriting existing tasks. Plain text tasks start incomplete. Up to 1,000 files and 10 MB total.
Import.conflict: Other dates found in the body or filename: {dates}. Check the schedule date.
Import.invalid: Invalid file or no tasks: UTF-8 MD only, up to 256 KB, 500 tasks and 160 characters per task.
Import.limit: Select up to 1,000 files with a combined size of 10 MB.
Import.failed: Import could not be confirmed. Retry safely; duplicate tasks will be skipped.

Export.hint: Select years, months or days to download a ZIP. Completion and optional status are preserved.
Export.receiving: Packing and receiving files: {size} KB received…
Export.saveHint: The file was sent to your browser. Check your downloads list.
Export.emptyDay: No todos for this day; they may have been deleted.
Export.readFailed: Could not read this day. Please retry.

Todo.title: Today's todos
Todo.emptyDescription: Use the New Todo button to add the first item. This placeholder keeps the day view grounded when the list is empty.
